en: I had dinner with my friends yesterday.
I didn't have dinner because I was busy.
Did you (m.) have dinner at home today?
Why didn't you (m.) have dinner with us yesterday?

lat: wach t3echchiti mzyan l-bare7 f l-lil
en: Did you (f.) have a good dinner last night?
You (f.) didn't have much dinner yesterday.
He had dinner early today.

ar: هو ما تعشاش حيت فيه النعاس
en: He didn't have dinner because he was sleepy.
My sister had dinner at the restaurant with us.
She didn't have dinner because she is sick.
We had dinner at my grandfather's house yesterday.

ar: حنا ما تعشيناش حيت وصلنا معطلين
en: We didn't have dinner because we arrived late.
Did you (pl.) have dinner at home?
You (pl.) didn't have dinner with the family.
The parents had dinner early yesterday.

lat: huma ma t3echchawch f l-util l-bare7
en: They didn't have dinner at the hotel yesterday.
I always have dinner at nine.

lat: ana ma kant3echchach bezzaf f l-lil
en: I do not eat much dinner at night.
You (m.) always have dinner at home.
You (m.) do not eat dinner with your close friends.
Do you (f.) have dinner early every day?

lat: nti ma katt3echchaych f l-lil kul nhar
ar: نتي ما كتتعشايش فالليل كل نهار
en: You (f.) do not eat dinner at night every day.
He always has dinner with his parents.

lat: huwa ma kayt3echchach f had l-weqt
en: He does not have dinner at this time.

lat: hiya katt3echcha f l-kuzina kul lila
en: She has dinner in the kitchen every night.
She does not eat dinner at night.

ar: حنا كنتعشاو كل نهار مع العايلة
en: We have dinner every day with the family.
We do not always have dinner outside.
Do you (pl.) have dinner early every night?
You (pl.) do not have dinner on time.

lat: huma kayt3echchaw kul nhar f r-restoran
en: They have dinner every day at the restaurant.

lat: huma ma kayt3echchawch m3ana f d-dar
en: They do not have dinner with us at home.

lat: ana ghadi nt3echcha m3a khuya l-yum
ar: أنا غادي نتعشا مع خويا اليوم
en: I am going to have dinner with my brother today.

lat: ana ma ghadich nt3echcha l-yum f l-lil
ar: أنا ما غاديش نتعشا اليوم فالليل
en: I am not going to have dinner tonight.

lat: wach nta ghadi tt3echcha m3ana ghedda
ar: واش نتا غادي تتعشا معانا غدا
en: Are you (m.) going to have dinner with us tomorrow?

lat: nta ma ghadich tt3echcha f had r-restoran
ar: نتا ما غاديش تتعشا فهاد الريستوران
en: You (m.) are not going to have dinner at this restaurant.

lat: wach nti ghadi tt3echchay bkri l-yum
ar: واش نتي غادي تتعشاي بكري اليوم
en: Are you (f.) going to have dinner early today?

lat: ma ghadich tt3echchay m3ana f d-dar
en: You (f.) are not going to have dinner with us at home.

lat: huwa ghadi yt3echcha m3a sa7bu l-yum
ar: هو غادي يتعشا مع صاحبو اليوم
en: He is going to have dinner with his friend today.

ar: هو ما غاديش يتعشا حيت شبعان
en: He is not going to have dinner because he is full.

lat: khti ghadi tt3echcha m3a bentha l-yum
ar: ختي غادي تتعشا مع بنتها اليوم
en: My sister is going to have dinner with her daughter today.

lat: hiya ma ghadich tt3echcha f d-dar l-lila
ar: هي ما غاديش تتعشا فالدار الليلة
en: She is not going to have dinner at home tonight.

ar: حنا غادي نتعشاو مع عايلتنا غدا
en: We are going to have dinner with our family tomorrow.

lat: 7na ma ghadich nt3echchaw f had r-restoran
ar: حنا ما غاديش نتعشاو فهاد الريستوران
en: We are not going to have dinner at this restaurant.

lat: wach ntuma ghadi tt3echchaw m3ana ghedda
ar: واش نتوما غادي تتعشاو معانا غدا
en: Are you (pl.) going to have dinner with us tomorrow?

lat: ntuma ma ghadich tt3echchaw m3etlin l-yum
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تتعشاو معطلين اليوم
en: You (pl.) are not going to have dinner late today.

lat: huma ghadi yt3echchaw f l-mdina ghedda
en: They are going to have dinner in the medina tomorrow.

lat: huma ma ghadich yt3echchaw m3ana l-lila
ar: هما ما غاديش يتعشاو معانا الليلة
en: They are not going to have dinner with us tonight.
